text:
hana_sales: Incoming from EU banking customer. RFP asks: can we run a 10-day EU-only POC on Hosted and provide artifacts proving no production traffic left EU? they don't want Dedicated yet.
rob_se: short: Hosted can be configured with tenant-region affinity and we can run a scoped policy for the POC window. it minimizes cross-region egress but doesn't provide a contractual absolute guarantee. for that, Dedicated/Private+BYOK is required.
kevin_ops: ops can create a temporary "pin-to-eu" routing rule for the tenant and disable automatic cross-region fallback for the test window. we will enable netflow exports and a KMS-region audit. note: this change is manual and needs an ops ticket + on-call approval.
hana_sales: can we hand them packet-level evidence or just logs?
kevin_ops: we can give netflow CSVs and connection-level summaries. full pcaps are sensitive and usually not shared; we can offer sanitized connection traces showing endpoints and regions.
marta_security: compliance note: Hosted uses our managed key infrastructure by default (multi-region). for cryptographic residency evidence during POC we can spin up a scoped regional key and provide audit logs, but any contract language promising "keys never left EU" requires Dedicated/Private with BYOK.
hana_sales: procurement will ask about price delta if they later convert to Dedicated for guarantees.
zach_finance: ballpark numbers: Dedicated/reserved capacity typically ranges from ~2x to ~6x hosted unit costs depending on model family and commit size. we can model a migration quote after the POC.
rob_se: also offer a middle ground: a regional reservation (smaller monthly commit) to reduce fallback risk and give a stronger SLA without full Dedicated. availability depends on capacity.
hannah_sales: (typo) hana_sales: noted. any sub-processor caveats we should call out?
marta_security: observability vendor control planes are sometimes US-based even when EU ingest is used. we will produce an annex listing sub-processors and indicate which control planes are multi-region. for the POC we'll produce exported artifacts and a scoped data handling statement.
kevin_ops: deliverables for POC: 1) routing policy screenshot and change log, 2) netflow CSV for tenant, 3) KMS region audit CSV for the scoped key, 4) sub-processor annex, 5) short processing-path diagram.
rd-bot: ticket RD-POC-888 opened and assigned to @kevin_ops and @rob_se. start target in 3 business days.
hana_sales: great. Marta can you draft a one-paragraph RFP response we can paste?
marta_security: suggested: "Redwood supports tenant-scoped regional affinity in our Hosted offering and can enable timeboxed operational policies to constrain processing to EU capacity for POCs. Redwood can provide operational evidence (netflow exports, KMS region audit logs, processing path diagrams) for the POC. For contractual and cryptographic guarantees of exclusive in-region processing, Dedicated or Private deployments with customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) are required."
zach_finance: i'll prepare a short cost appendix for procurement comparing hosted, regional reservation, and Dedicated.
hana_sales: i'll send this to the customer and paste back their questionnaire. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
